INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Mechanics of writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Mechanics of writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Mechanics of writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Mechanics of writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Mechanics of writing.

2. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
